caption:
Stock market news | RBI links weaker rupee to higher G-sec yields

The Reserve Bank of India released a study indicating that monetary news from the US Federal Reserve leads to a weaker Indian rupee.

The same Fed news also pushes up yields on Indian government securities, affecting borrowing costs and market sentiment.
